plan.scope: Exploratory development set: one manually judged query, 16 clips, 2 positives; no held-out test.
positives: A baseball batter bunting the ball.
A baseball batter attempting a bunt, holding the bat horizontally in front of the body to meet the pitch.
A baseball hitter squares around to bunt, extending the bat in front of home plate.
A baseball player gently taps a pitch with the bat held out, attempting a bunt.
negatives: A baseball batter waiting for a pitch, holding the bat up near the shoulder.
A baseball batter taking a full swing at a pitch.
A baseball pitcher delivering a pitch while the batter watches.
plan.crop_rule: home_plate: fixed normalized box (0.25, 0.10, 0.80, 0.70), same for every frame; not object detection
plan.contrastive_rule: mean positive-prompt cosine minus max negative-prompt cosine, then clip pooling
plan.selection: highest Recall@3, then RR, then Precision@3; ties prefer simpler variant by run order
